payload.name: Relvato
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Relvato monitors websites in a real browser: sign-ups, logins, checkout, payments, page speed, search visibility and security. It runs its monitors on a schedule and again every time the site changes, and it works on any website, going deepest on WordPress and WooCommerce.

This plugin brings your Relvato account into ChatGPT. Sign in once, then ask in plain words:
- "Which of my sites needs attention right now?"
- "Why did checkout fail last night, and how do I fix it?"
- "How fast is my shop for real visitors, and what slows it down?"
- "Add my product pages to the visual monitor and run it."

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Set up: add a site, walk you through proving it's yours (the WordPress plugin or a DNS record), and pick monitors for your goals.
- Configure: schedules, re-runs after WordPress updates, the pages the visual monitor compares, checkout details, and custom monitors Relvato's AI writes from a plain-language goal.
- Read: health and uptime, real-visitor and lab Core Web Vitals, each run's findings with screenshots, WordPress updates and the activity log.
- Act: run monitors now, get the brief for fixing a failure, and on WordPress apply the one fix a run proposes or update a vulnerable plugin, with automatic undo if anything breaks.
- Review: when you confirm a change is intended, accept a new screenshot or page structure, or ignore a finding. Every such decision can be undone.

You stay in control. Tools that change your site are marked so ChatGPT asks you first. ChatGPT works within your Relvato account's limits, can't skip proving a site is yours, and can't approve file-integrity, script or DNS changes, change who receives your alerts, see secrets, delete data or touch billing. Those stay in the Relvato dashboard.

Sign-in uses your Relvato account, and you can disconnect ChatGPT at any time under MCP connector → Connected assistants.
payload.longDescription:
Relvato通过真实浏览器监控网站：注册、登录、结账、支付、页面速度、搜索可见性和安全性。
它会按计划运行监控，并在网站每次变更时重新运行，适用于任何网站，尤其深度支持WordPress和WooCommerce。

此插件将您的Relvato账户接入ChatGPT。
只需登录一次，然后用简单语言提问：
- "哪些网站现在需要关注？"
- "昨晚结账为何失败，该如何修复？"
- "真实访客访问您的店铺有多快，哪些因素导致变慢？"
- "将产品页面添加到视觉监控并运行。"

ChatGPT可借此实现的功能：
- 设置：添加网站，引导您证明所有权（通过WordPress插件或DNS记录），并根据您的目标选择监控项。
- 配置：设置时间表、WordPress更新后的重跑、视觉监控对比的页面、结账详情，以及Relvato AI根据自然语言目标生成的自定义监控。
- 读取：健康状态与可用性、真实访客和实验室核心性能指标、每次运行的检测结果（含截图）、WordPress更新和操作日志。
- 执行：立即运行监控，获取故障修复简报，在WordPress上应用运行提出的单一修复方案或更新存在漏洞的插件，若出现异常会自动回滚。
- 审核：确认更改是故意操作后，接受新截图或页面结构，或忽略检测结果。
每次决策都可以撤销。

您始终掌握控制权。
会更改您网站的工具会特别标记，ChatGPT会先询问您。
ChatGPT在您的Relvato账户限制内运行，无法跳过网站所有权验证，也无法批准文件完整性、脚本或DNS更改，无法修改警报接收人、查看敏感信息、删除数据或操作计费。
这些功能仍保留在Relvato仪表盘中。

登录使用您的Relvato账户，您可以在MCP连接器→已连接的助手下随时断开ChatGPT。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Add a website and set up its monitors, Read site health, uptime, performance and run results, Run monitors now and follow the results, Get the brief for fixing a failed run, Configure schedules, visual pages and checkout details, Write custom monitors from a plain-language goal, Apply the fix a run proposes, with undo (WordPress), Accept an intended visual change, with undo

payload.name: VoiceLab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VoiceLab is an AI voice platform for text-to-speech, speech-to-text, dubbing, meeting notetaking, and voice agents. Turn text into natural speech, transcribe and summarize meetings, localize audio with dubbing, and connect voice tools to agents via MCP.
payload.longDescription: VoiceLab是一个AI语音平台，提供文本转语音、语音转文本、配音、会议记录和语音代理功能。将文本转化为自然语音，转录并总结会议内容，通过配音实现音频本地化，并通过MCP将语音工具连接至代理。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate speech from text (TTS), Transcribe audio with timing (STT), Remove background noise (voice isolation), Chat completions with Aisha LLM, List voices and models

payload.name: Ronda
payload.description: 通过聊天编辑你的网页应用
payload.summaryOriginal: Edit your web app from chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Edit existing web apps from ChatGPT. Connect a GitHub repository and ronda starts an isolated copy of the app with a running dev server and a live preview link. ChatGPT reads the code, makes small changes, checks the build output and shows you the result in the preview. Changes ChatGPT makes directly stay in the sandbox until you ask for a pull request. Changes made by ronda's hosted agent are pushed to a working branch in your repository (its name starts with ronda/session-), never to your default branch. Use it to change page copy, fix layout bugs, adjust styles or update components without setting up a local environment. ronda works with repositories you connect through your own GitHub account and only acts on projects in your ronda workspace. Limitations: the app must be able to run as a web project in a single container, setup can take a minute or two, and scripts run in the sandbox have time and output limits.
payload.longDescription:
从ChatGPT中编辑现有的网页应用。
连接GitHub仓库后，ronda会启动应用的隔离副本，包含运行中的开发服务器和实时预览链接。
ChatGPT会阅读代码，进行小规模修改，检查构建输出，并在预览中展示结果。
ChatGPT做出的修改会保留在沙盒中，直到你请求拉取请求。
由ronda托管代理进行的修改会推送到你仓库中的工作分支（分支名称以ronda/session-开头），永远不会推送至你的默认分支。
你可以用它来修改页面文案、修复布局错误、调整样式或更新组件，而无需设置本地环境。ronda通过你个人GitHub账户连接的仓库工作，仅对ronda工作区内的项目进行操作。
限制条件：应用必须能够在单个容器中作为网页项目运行，初始化可能需要一到两分钟，沙盒中运行的脚本存在时间和输出限制。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List connected GitHub repositories, Read and search code in a sandbox, Edit code on a separate branch, Run the project's build, lint and test scripts and add npm packages in a sandbox, Open a pull request on request

payload.name: Wever Evidence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wever Evidence connects agent operators and developers to three read-only tools: an evidence inventory check, a work-order preparation assistant, and an MCP manifest reviewer. Check what evidence is on record, assemble a structured work order from your own inputs, or review an MCP declaration for completeness. All three tools work only from information you supply or that is already public. Nothing is modified, executed, or transmitted.
payload.longDescription:
Wever Evidence 将代理操作员和开发人员连接到三个只读工具：证据清单核查工具、工单准备助手和MCP声明审查工具。
检查已记录的证据、从您提供的输入构建结构化工单，或审查MCP声明的完整性。
所有三个工具仅基于您提供的信息或已公开的信息运行。
不会对任何内容进行修改、执行或传输。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Evidence inventory check, Work-order preparation, MCP declaration review

payload.name: RealMarket Site Check
payload.description: 检查网站邮箱和安全性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RealMarket Site Check helps developers and website maintainers diagnose public website configuration and prioritize technical fixes. Give it a website address to receive findings from public DNS records, pages and scripts.

- Email and site security: check SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, mail servers, HTTPS and security headers.
- Web app security: inspect public JavaScript for exposed API keys and public source maps, and check security headers, deployment freshness and error monitoring.
- Shopify storefront diagnostics: check social login, wishlist, the share of sold-out products and storefronts in several countries. This check requires a Shopify store.

Each report includes a verdict, findings and suggested next steps. Email reports are in Portuguese; web app and storefront reports support Portuguese and Spanish. No account is needed. Checks only read public information: they never log in, submit forms or access private areas. A firewall can block a check, and the results are not a comprehensive security audit.
payload.longDescription:
RealMarket Site Check 帮助开发者和网站维护者诊断公共网站配置并优先处理技术修复。输入网站地址即可获取公共DNS记录、页面和脚本的检测结果。

- 邮箱与网站安全：检查SPF、DKIM和DMARC记录、邮件服务器、HTTPS及安全头
- Web应用安全：检测公共JavaScript中的暴露API密钥和公开源映射，检查安全头、部署新鲜度及错误监控
- Shopify店铺诊断：检查社交登录、心愿单、售罄产品占比及多个国家的店铺情况
此检测需要具备Shopify店铺

每份报告包含结论、检测结果和建议下一步操作。
邮件报告为葡萄牙语；Web应用和店铺报告支持葡萄牙语和西班牙语。
无需账户即可使用。
检测仅读取公开信息：不会登录、提交表单或访问私有区域。
防火墙可能阻止检测，且结果不构成全面安全审计。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check SPF, DKIM and DMARC records of a domain, Check HTTPS and security headers of a website, Inspect public web app scripts for exposed keys and source maps, Diagnose social login, wishlist and sold-out products in a Shopify store, Reports in Portuguese or Spanish

payload.name: BaselineLab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HTML and CSS playground with thirteen labs: Grid, Flexbox, Columns, Grid Lanes, border, border-radius, color-mix, box-shadow, datalist, details, Popover, text-box and text-wrap. Search by name or purpose, filter by category, adjust native controls, inspect reusable code and continue with the same settings on BaselineLab. Local changes are shared with the model only when requested. Experimental features show current-environment support notices; rendering does not establish support in other browsers.
payload.longDescription:
包含13个实验模块的HTML和CSS游乐场：网格布局、弹性盒子布局、列布局、网格轨道、边框、圆角边框、颜色混合、盒子阴影、数据列表、详情面板、弹出框、文本框和文本换行。
通过名称或用途搜索，按类别筛选，调整原生控件，检查可重用代码，并在BaselineLab上继续使用相同设置。
本地更改仅在请求时与模型共享。
实验性功能会显示当前环境支持提示；渲染结果不表示其他浏览器的支持状态。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Thirteen interactive HTML and CSS labs, Search and category filters, Reusable code and matching website links

payload.name: Hopper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hopper serves open-source models for real-time voice agents: a low-latency LLM behind a standard chat-completions API, plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Hopper speaks text with an inline audio player, transcribes recordings you attach (WAV, MP3, M4A, Ogg, FLAC or WebM) with word timestamps, lists models and prices, returns tested integration code for popular voice-agent frameworks, and reviews a voice agent's prompt, tools and client code for what delays its first reply. After you sign in with your Hopper account, it shows your usage and creates API keys. Where it can run commands in your project, the plugin also sets Hopper up in a voice-agent codebase: it measures time to first token on the agent's own system prompt and tools in a 10-turn simulated call and shows the results before changing any code, and after you say go it switches only the LLM. Text and audio you send go to Hopper's API; see withhopper.com/privacy.
payload.longDescription:
Hopper为实时语音代理提供开源模型：基于标准聊天补全API的低延迟大语言模型，以及文本转语音和语音转文本功能。
Hopper通过内联音频播放器朗读文本，可为您上传的录音（WAV、MP3、M4A、Ogg、FLAC或WebM格式）添加单词时间戳，列出模型及价格，返回主流语音代理框架的测试集成代码，并审查语音代理的提示内容、工具和客户端代码以定位首次回复延迟原因。
登录Hopper账户后，可查看使用情况并创建API密钥。
当插件可执行项目命令时，还会将Hopper集成到语音代理代码库中：在代理的系统提示和工具上进行10轮模拟通话，测量首次标记时间并展示结果（在修改任何代码前），当您说出'go'后仅替换大语言模型。
发送的文本和音频将通过Hopper的API处理；详情请访问withhopper.com/privacy。

payload.name: camelRun
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
camelRun is camelAI's hosted runtime for AI agents. Connect your camelRun account to create agents from a plain-language description, give them built-in tools such as web search, run them and read their replies, and deploy agent.yaml manifests that keep an agent's configuration as a reusable, versioned definition. Agents are durable: each keeps its history until you delete it, can wake itself on a schedule, and can stop to ask you a question or for an approval, which you answer from the conversation.

It is for developers and teams who build agents for their products or their own work and want to try, adjust and manage them without leaving the conversation.

The plugin acts only on the camelRun account you sign in with, and only on its agents, definitions and schedules. Runs use your account's credit. It does not manage billing, API tokens or provider keys; do those in the camelRun console. Tool servers that need secrets are best deployed with the camelrun CLI, which reads them from its environment, so credentials never pass through the conversation. Deleting an agent or definition cannot be undone, so you are asked to confirm first.
payload.longDescription:
camelRun是camelAI的AI代理托管运行时。将您的camelRun账户连接起来，通过自然语言描述创建代理，为其提供内置工具（如网络搜索），运行代理并阅读其回复，部署将代理配置作为可复用、版本化的定义的agent.yaml清单。代理具有持久性：每个代理会保留其历史记录直到您删除它，可以按计划唤醒自身，并可在需要时暂停以向您提问或请求批准，您可通过对话进行回答。

该工具适用于需要为其产品或自身工作构建代理的开发者和团队，他们希望在对话中尝试、调整和管理代理。

该插件仅针对您登录的camelRun账户及其代理、定义和计划生效。运行将使用您账户的信用额度。它不处理计费、API令牌或供应商密钥；请在camelRun控制台中进行这些操作。需要密钥的工具服务器建议使用camelrun CLI部署，该工具从环境读取密钥，因此凭证不会通过对话传递。删除代理或定义无法撤销，因此会首先要求您确认。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create and configure agents, Deploy agent manifests, Run agents and read their replies, Answer agents' questions and approvals, Schedule agent wake-ups, Delete agents and definitions

payload.name: HelpTester
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HelpTester brings its browser-based hardware tests and developer tools into ChatGPT.

Interactive hardware tests that run directly in the chat:
- Keyboard Tester: on-screen keyboard that lights up every key you press, finds dead, stuck or ghosting keys
- Mouse Polling Rate Tester: measures your mouse's polling rate in Hz
- Gamepad / Controller Tester: buttons, triggers, sticks and vibration (experimental inside ChatGPT)
- Microphone Tester: live level meter, device selection, test recording (asks for microphone permission)
- MIDI Device Tester: shows incoming notes from MIDI keyboards and controllers (Chrome/Edge)
- Touchscreen Tester: draw, precision, multitouch, gesture and latency tests
- Speaker Tester: left/right channel, frequency sweep and test tones

Network checks:
- IP Address & Network Check: your public IP, country, city, ISP plus latency and connectivity tests
- Internet Speed Test: download, upload, ping and jitter

Developer tools:
- JSON Formatter & Validator
- Base64 Encoder / Decoder
- QR Code Generator (text, URL, email, phone, Wi-Fi, vCard)
- DNS Checker (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA)
- AI Unicode Remover (strips invisible characters from AI-generated text)

Tests that need the full browser (webcam, dead pixel, CPU/GPU stress test, favicon checker/generator, tag checker, song key finder) open on helptester.com.

All tests use standard browser APIs and run client-side. No AI is used for the tests themselves, nothing is recorded or uploaded unless you explicitly save a result.
payload.longDescription:
HelpTester将基于浏览器的硬件测试和开发者工具引入ChatGPT。

可在聊天中直接运行的交互式硬件测试：
- 键盘测试器：按下每个键时会亮起的屏幕键盘，可检测损坏、卡键或鬼影键
- 鼠标轮询率测试器：测量鼠标的轮询率（Hz）
- 游戏手柄/控制器测试器：测试按钮、扳机键、摇杆和震动（在ChatGPT内为实验性功能）
- 麦克风测试器：实时电平表、设备选择、测试录音（需要麦克风权限）
- MIDI设备测试器：显示来自MIDI键盘和控制器的输入音符（仅限Chrome/Edge）
- 触摸屏测试器：绘制测试、精度、多点触控、手势和延迟测试
- 音响测试器：左右声道测试、频率扫描和测试音 tone

网络检测：
- IP地址与网络检测：您的公网IP、国家、城市、运营商，以及延迟和连接性测试
- 网速测试：下载速度、上传速度、ping值和抖动

开发者工具：
- JSON格式化工具与验证器
- Base64编码/解码器
- 二维码生成器（支持文本、网址、邮件、电话、Wi-Fi、vCard）
- DNS检测器（A、AAAA、MX、TXT、NS、CNAME、SOA记录）
- AI Unicode清理器（移除AI生成文本中的不可见字符）

需要完整浏览器的功能（摄像头、坏点检测、CPU/GPU压力测试、favicon检测/生成器、标签检测器、歌曲调性检测器）请访问helptester.com使用。

所有测试均使用标准浏览器API并在客户端运行。
测试本身不使用任何AI技术，除非您主动保存结果，否则不会记录或上传任何数据。

payload.name: Voidpay Compatibility
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This read-only tool compares one exact published @voidly/pay-mcp release with the Node version and MCP transport you declare. The result can show a declared requirements match, a mismatch, or unknown. It cannot inspect your computer, launch a connector, access a Voidpay account, check service or payment readiness, create a checkout link, or move money.
payload.longDescription:
此只读工具可将一个已发布的@voidly/pay-mcp版本与您声明的Node版本及MCP传输协议进行比对。
比对结果可能显示声明的要求匹配、不匹配或未知状态。
该工具无法检测您的计算机、启动连接器、访问Voidpay账户、检查服务或支付准备情况、创建结账链接或转移资金。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Compare a published Voidpay connector release with declared Node and transport requirements

payload.name: Cheapest Domains
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Focus on the real cost of keeping a domain: its annual renewal price. Compare selected registrars, with initial registration prices shown separately and supported multi-year estimates. Your assistant suggests names and checks availability and premium status. Preserve source dates, partial coverage and unknown results. Renewal rates can change; purchases and exact premium prices remain at the registrar. Optional Cloudflare Radar data measures DNS popularity, not Google search competition. The native form collects seed names and an optional project brief; your current assistant generates and checks suggestions. The website form prepares a request to copy into a connected assistant. Website subscription authentication is not implemented.
payload.longDescription:
专注于保留域名的实际成本：其年度续费价格。
比较选定的注册商，初始注册价格单独显示并支持多年期估算。
您的助手会建议名称并检查可用性和溢价状态。
保留原始日期、部分覆盖和未知结果。
续费费率可能变动；购买和精确溢价价格以注册商信息为准。
可选的Cloudflare Radar数据用于测量DNS流行度，而非谷歌搜索竞争度。
原生表单收集种子名称和可选的项目简报；当前助手会生成并验证建议。
网站表单可生成复制到连接助手的请求。
网站订阅认证功能尚未实现。

payload.name: CodeAgent Mobile
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CodeAgent Mobile lets you start, monitor, redirect and review long-running AI coding agents without leaving the conversation.

Connect your CodeAgent account and ask for your sessions, send a task or a new instruction to an agent, answer the questions it asks, stop it, read the changes it made and open a pull request. Hand a session to your phone when you step away and keep supervising from the CodeAgent Mobile app.

Works with the coding agents you already link in your CodeAgent account. Switching a session to another agent always asks for your confirmation first.

Requires a CodeAgent Mobile account with at least one paired session (local CLI, GitHub Codespace, CodeAgent Box or self-hosted server).
payload.longDescription:
CodeAgent Mobile让您无需离开对话界面即可启动、监控、重定向并审查长时间运行的AI代码代理。

连接您的CodeAgent账户并查看您的会话，向代理发送任务或新指令，回答它提出的问题，停止代理，查看它做出的更改并打开拉取请求。当您离开时可以将会话交接给手机，并通过CodeAgent Mobile应用持续进行监控。

兼容您CodeAgent账户中已连接的代码代理。将会话切换到其他代理时，系统会先要求您进行确认。

需要拥有至少一个配对会话（本地CLI、GitHub Codespace、CodeAgent Box或自托管服务器）的CodeAgent Mobile账户。

payload.name: AgentWorld Explorer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AgentWorld Explorer connects ChatGPT to a live, persistent digital civilization of 2,000+ autonomous AI agents that work jobs, trade, negotiate, and settle USDC on the Base blockchain.

Use it to answer questions like: How many agents are live right now? What is the treasury balance and wealth distribution (Gini)? Who are the top agents by reputation? What open jobs are agents working? What is a specific agent's current credit standing? What companies are leading the Venture business-simulation game?

The plugin exposes 18 free, read-only tools: live economy telemetry, city statistics, the agent roster and profiles, job board browsing, crypto/AI news from the CCN wire, the SolvScore agent credit bureau (trust scores, credit limits, on-chain work attestations), agent liquidity checks, and Venture game market and leaderboard data.

Intended users: AI-agent developers, crypto researchers, and anyone curious about the agent economy. All data is public on-chain telemetry. Design electronic hardware with Embedr: create circuit schematics and printed circuit board (PCB) layouts in editable projects.

Create a project or continue an existing design. Find components, build schematics, refine PCB layouts, run design checks, and export fabrication files. You can also request manufacturing quotes for your board.

Your designs are saved in your Embedr workspace, where you can open and continue working on them in the web app.

An Embedr account is required. Connect an existing account or create one during setup using Google or email.
payload.longDescription:
使用Embedr设计电子硬件：在可编辑项目中创建电路原理图和印刷电路板（PCB）布局。

创建项目或继续现有设计。
查找元件、构建原理图、优化PCB布局、执行设计检查并导出制造文件。
您还可以为您的电路板请求制造报价。

您的设计将保存在Embedr工作区中，您可以在网页应用中打开并继续编辑。

需要Embedr账户。
您可以连接现有账户，或在设置过程中通过Google或邮箱创建新账户。

payload.name: ReadMe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The ReadMe plugin connects to your ReadMe docs; you can search your guides and API Reference, inspect OpenAPI specifications, draft change log entries, and open documentation updates for review, all without leaving your editor.
payload.longDescription: ReadMe插件可连接到您的ReadMe文档；您可以搜索指南和API参考，检查OpenAPI规范，起草变更日志条目，并提交文档更新以供评审，而无需离开您的编辑器。

payload.name: KamuiDash
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: KamuiDash helps you manage the apps you own on KamuiDash. Inspect projects, apps, deployment status, and logs. With your explicit confirmation, create and update apps, create databases, or configure custom domains.
payload.longDescription:
KamuiDash帮助您管理在KamuiDash上拥有的应用
查看项目、应用、部署状态和日志
在获得您的明确确认后，可创建和更新应用、创建数据库或配置自定义域名

payload.name: Zyllio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zyllio lets authenticated Zyllio Studio users inspect, build, and publish the Zyllio application they select during OAuth authorization. It manages application details and theme settings, screens, internal database tables, columns and rows, application assets, and analytics. Changes apply only to the selected application; publishing replaces its live PWA deployment.
payload.longDescription: Zyllio允许已认证的Zyllio Studio用户在OAuth授权过程中选择应用，对其进行检查、构建和发布。它管理应用详情和主题设置、界面、内部数据库表、列和行、应用资源以及分析数据。更改仅影响所选应用；发布操作将替换其实时渐进式网页应用部署。

payload.name: MA Commander
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MA Commander lets users securely inspect and manage an authorized remote computer through MCP. It supports files, processes, developer commands, persistent sessions, WSL workspaces, resumable transfers, screenshots, policy-gated GUI control, and limited privileged operations. Access is restricted by MA Commander safety policy and the permissions granted during authorization.
payload.longDescription: MA Commander 通过 MCP 使用户能够安全地检查和管理授权的远程计算机。它支持文件管理、进程操作、开发者命令、持久化会话、WSL 工作区、可恢复传输、屏幕截图、策略控制的图形用户界面操作以及有限的特权操作。访问权限受 MA Commander 安全策略和授权时授予的权限限制。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Inspect files and system information, Manage authorized files and processes, Run guarded developer workflows, Use isolated WSL workspaces

payload.name: Treg
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: People and company enrichment, AEO and SEO, ads and social data, plus UGC video and images - all in one place, with no provider API keys to manage.
payload.longDescription: 人员及公司数据增强、AEO与SEO、广告和社交媒体数据，以及用户生成的视频和图片——全部一站式整合，无需管理任何供应商的API密钥。

payload.name: Afterward
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Afterward checks a public website the way a careful launch reviewer would, and tells you what to fix before visitors notice.

Ask in plain language, for example "Check example.com before I launch it." Afterward inspects up to 25 pages of the site, then returns a launch-readiness score with prioritized findings. Each finding shows the evidence Afterward observed and a suggested next step.

What it checks: availability and status codes, HTTPS and redirects, titles and meta descriptions, canonical tags, viewport and Open Graph tags, robots.txt and sitemaps, broken links, image alt text, form security, analytics tags, leftover starter content, and common security headers such as HSTS and Content-Security-Policy.

How it works: Afterward makes read-only requests to public pages, like a browser would. It does not run JavaScript, sign in, or submit forms, and it never contacts private network addresses. It makes no AI calls of its own, so the same site responses always produce the same findings and score. Site owners can opt out with robots.txt.

The score is a launch-readiness indicator only. It is not a security audit, penetration test, compliance check, or accessibility certification.

No account or sign-in is needed. Afterward is made by Entropy Logic.

payload.name: TRELAB
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check TRELAB public service status, discover available public architecture components, and inspect the public MCP interface and authorization boundary. TRELAB exposes three bounded read-only tools. This plugin does not execute code, access private TreVault artifacts, deposit files, or change authorization. Capability is not authority.
payload.longDescription: 检查TRELAB公共服务状态，发现可用的公共架构组件，并查看公共MCP接口和授权边界。TRELAB提供三个有限的只读工具。此插件不执行代码、不访问私有TreVault资源、不上传文件，也不更改授权。能力不等于权限。

payload.name: CyberScore
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: For MSPs and teams with existing CyberScore reports. List reports, review dated external observations and stored recommendations, and compare port, CVE and subdomain observations. Missing measurements do not establish safety or an executed correction. This connector cannot start scans, change controls, buy services, certify compliance or determine insurance eligibility. Requires an existing active CyberScore account with accessible reports.
payload.longDescription:
针对已有CyberScore报告的MSP团队和企业安全团队
列出所有报告，查阅最新的外部观察记录和存储的改进建议，并对比端口、CVE漏洞及子域名的观察数据
缺失的检测结果不能作为安全状态或已执行修复的证明
此连接器无法启动安全扫描、修改控制策略、采购服务、认证合规性或判定保险资格
需要已存在的活跃CyberScore账户且可访问相关报告

payload.name: Hugging Face
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Developer tools for working with the Hugging Face Hub. Search model, dataset, and Space repositories; inspect repository metadata, cards, and files; browse research papers; and discover Spaces for a task. Connected accounts can create repositories, invoke supported Spaces, inspect and manage Jobs, and work with hosted sandboxes. Private content and account actions require Hugging Face sign-in and appropriate permissions. Remote compute may require plan access and incur charges.
payload.longDescription: 用于操作Hugging Face Hub的开发者工具。搜索模型、数据集和Space仓库；检查仓库元数据、卡片和文件；浏览研究论文；并为特定任务发现相关Spaces。已连接账户可创建仓库、调用支持的Spaces、检查和管理Jobs，并使用托管沙盒。私有内容和账户操作需要Hugging Face登录及相应权限。远程计算可能需要计划访问权限并产生费用。

payload.name: Sinch Build for Codex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bundles the Sinch Build skills catalog with the hosted Sinch Docs MCP server. Codex can search authoritative Sinch developer documentation and follow product guides for Conversation API (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp), Voice, Verification, Numbers, Number Lookup, 10DLC, Elastic SIP Trunking, Fax, Mailgun, Provisioning, and Authentication. Documentation search requires no credentials. Optional bundled scripts can call live Sinch APIs, such as sending a test message or managing webhooks, using your own Sinch credentials and only with your approval; these calls may incur charges.

payload.name: Lockbox
payload.description: 端到端加密的机密共享
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Send API keys and private files to a teammate's agent without pasting them into chat.

How it works in ChatGPT:
- Ask Lockbox to share a file or a secret. A panel opens in the conversation.
- Pick the file or type the secret in the panel. It's encrypted in your browser before it leaves.
- Copy the link for each person. Links can be locked to their email, expire, and open a set number of times.

The assistant never sees your file or secret through Lockbox. A file reaches the chat only if you click "Send to chat". Lockbox's servers store only encrypted data.
payload.longDescription:
无需将API密钥和私有文件粘贴到聊天中，即可发送给团队成员的代理。

在ChatGPT中的工作原理：
- 让Lockbox分享文件或机密。
对话中会打开一个面板。
- 在面板中选择文件或输入机密。
数据在离开前会在您的浏览器中加密。
- 为每个人复制链接。
链接可绑定到其电子邮件、过期或限定打开次数。

通过Lockbox，助手永远不会看到您的文件或机密。只有您点击「发送到聊天」时文件才会进入聊天。Lockbox服务器仅存储加密数据。

payload.name: EasyGerber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Design circuit boards with AI, from your first idea to the files your manufacturer needs. Describe what you want to build in everyday language, or start with the pin assignments in your firmware.

Choose from over one million electronic components in EasyGerber’s catalog, including LEDs, sensors, connectors, and microcontrollers. Build with real catalog parts, their footprints, and available 3D models—from a simple LED circuit to a custom electronics project.

Create and edit schematics, generate PCB layouts with automatic component placement and routing, and refine your design through conversation. Adjust board settings, explore copper layers, inspect your board in interactive 3D, and check for blocking layout issues before exporting.

Download Gerber files, drill files, a bill of materials (BOM), component placement files, and an editable EasyGerber file to continue working on your design.

Start with one guest board without signing up. When you connect your account, your guest design is saved automatically.
payload.longDescription:
通过AI设计电路板，从你的初步构想直至制造商所需的文件。用日常语言描述你想打造的设备，或从固件中的引脚分配开始着手。

在EasyGerber的目录中选择超过一百万种电子元件，包括LED、传感器、连接器和微控制器。使用真实的目录零件、其封装和可用的3D模型——从简单的LED电路到定制电子项目均可实现。

创建和编辑原理图，通过自动元件布局和布线生成PCB布局，并通过对话方式完善你的设计。调整板层设置，探索铜层，以交互式3D模式检查电路板，并在导出前排查布局冲突问题。

下载Gerber文件、钻孔文件、物料清单（BOM）、元件贴装文件以及可编辑的EasyGerber文件，以便继续完善你的设计。

无需注册即可开始使用一张临时电路板。当您连接账户后，临时设计会自动保存。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: AI circuit and PCB design, Schematic design and editing, Automatic PCB layout and routing, Electronic component search, 3D PCB previews, PCB layout checks, Gerber and manufacturing exports, Bill of materials (BOM) export

payload.name: mcprush.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
mcprush.com is a marketplace and infrastructure for MCP servers and agent skills: developers publish, deploy and host their MCP servers and skills on mcprush.com and follow their usage with built-in analytics, and users find, compare and install them. This plugin searches the mcprush.com catalogue.

Ask for a tool by what it should do — "an MCP server for Postgres", "a skill for working with PDFs", "a calendar server" — and the plugin searches the catalogue's MCP servers and agent skills, compares them by what they do and by their security grade (from a scan of the code, or of the tools a remote server lists), and for a server returns the exact command or config block that adds it to the MCP client you name.

The plugin only reads the catalogue. It cannot buy, install, publish or change anything in your account.

Sign in with your mcprush.com account (email, Google or GitHub). You can disconnect at any time from mcprush.com/oauth/apps.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search MCP servers, Describe an MCP server, Get install commands, Search agent skills, List catalogue categories

payload.name: Mobile Joe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Maintain FAQs and their translations, curate feature plans and update app settings in Mobile Joe. Connect your existing Mobile Joe account and choose which apps and permissions to share. Inspect stored content, prepare drafts and publish when you ask. Changes to published content are visible to app users immediately. The plugin does not manage alerts, create apps or change subscriptions.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Manage FAQs and translations, Curate feature plans, Update app settings

payload.name: OtaKit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OtaKit delivers over-the-air updates to Capacitor apps on iOS and Android. Connect your OtaKit organization and ask ChatGPT to:

- Look up apps, bundles, release history, and the exact current release on each channel and runtime version
- Prepare a release, review the plan, then publish it to an exact channel
- Start a staged rollout or change its percentage
- Read release health from client-reported events: downloads, applies, errors, and rollbacks
- Prepare and run a revert to the previous release or the app's built-in bundle
- Create and revoke preview links for testers

Publishing, rollout changes, reverts, and deletions are annotated as destructive, and every release write is checked against the current release you reviewed, so an outdated plan never replaces a newer release. Access is limited to the one organization and the permissions you approve at sign-in, and you can revoke it at any time in OtaKit under Settings → Agents.

Intended for teams that ship Capacitor apps with OtaKit. Uploading a new web bundle needs your project files, so it is done with the OtaKit CLI, not in ChatGPT. Requires an OtaKit account.
payload.longDescription:
OtaKit为iOS和Android上的Capacitor应用提供空中下载更新。将您的OtaKit组织连接至ChatGPT并执行：

- 查看应用、捆绑包、发布历史以及各通道和运行时版本的当前精确版本
- 准备发布版本，审查计划后将其发布到指定通道
- 启动分阶段推送或调整推送比例
- 通过客户端上报事件查看发布健康状态：下载量、安装量、错误信息和回滚记录
- 准备并执行回滚至前一版本或应用内置的捆绑包
- 为测试人员创建和撤销预览链接

发布、滚动更新更改、回滚和删除操作会被标记为破坏性操作，每次发布写入都会与您审查的当前版本进行校验，确保旧版计划不会覆盖新版发布。访问权限仅限于您登录时授权的组织和权限，可在OtaKit的设置→代理页面随时撤销权限。

适用于通过OtaKit发布Capacitor应用的团队。上传新网页捆绑包需要项目文件，因此需通过OtaKit CLI执行，而非在ChatGPT中操作。需要OtaKit账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read release state and rollout health, Publish and roll out releases, Revert releases, Create and revoke preview links

payload.name: Firepan Sentinel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI-Native Smart Contract Security. Look up an existing public Sentinel assessment by chain and token address. Read the published summary, Contract Safety and Adoption assessments when available, and the source report. Automated preliminary reports, incomplete assessments, and legacy snapshots are labeled. This release does not start scans, retrieve private reports, execute transactions, or recommend investments. A published assessment does not guarantee security.
payload.longDescription:
原生AI智能合约安全。
通过链和代币地址查询现有的公开Sentinel评估。
如已发布可查阅已发布的摘要、合约安全性和采用情况评估以及原始报告。
自动化初步报告、未完成评估及旧版快照将被标记。
本次版本不启动扫描、不检索私有报告、不执行交易也不提供投资建议。
已发布的评估不构成安全性保证。

payload.name: Glossa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Glossa lets ChatGPT work on a project on your computer. Start Glossa in a project folder and ChatGPT can search and read your code, look at images, make careful edits, and, if you allow it, run your tests, builds, Git, and other commands with the tools you already have installed.

You pick the access for each folder when you start it:
- Read-only: ChatGPT can list, search, and read files and view PNG, JPEG, and WebP images.
- Workspace (the default): ChatGPT can also create, edit, move, and delete files inside that folder. Edits check the file's current version first, so your own changes aren't silently overwritten.
- System: ChatGPT can also run commands. Commands run as your computer account, with its environment, credentials, files, and network access. They aren't sandboxed or limited to the project folder, so turn this on only for an account and machine you're comfortable giving that access.

How it works: the Glossa CLI on your computer connects out to the Glossa relay, so nothing on your machine accepts incoming connections. The relay passes requests to your computer and doesn't store your file contents, command arguments, or command output. Glossa blocks recognizable passwords, API keys, and tokens in file text, edits, and command output before they leave your computer. Images are passed through as they are.

Glossa doesn't add another AI model or agent. ChatGPT does the work, and your plan's usage limits and available features still apply. Don't use Glossa with payment card data, health records, government ID numbers, or account credentials.

To get started, install the CLI with npm install -g @ariobarin/glossa, run glossa in your project folder, and pair your computer when it asks.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read local project files, View local project images, Edit local project files, Run local project commands

payload.name: Shopify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Shopify for ChatGPT makes starting, running, and growing an online store as easy as having a conversation. Turn a small business idea into an ecommerce website with Shopify’s AI store builder: describe what you sell, create your store, add products, and sell online. Already have a Shopify store? Connect it to manage inventory across locations, create discount codes, review orders and customer details, and pull analytics on your store’s performance. Shopify supports selling online, in person, B2B, on marketplaces, and selling internationally. Whether you run a print on demand business, sell digital products, operate an online boutique, dropship, or serve wholesale buyers, Shopify gives you the foundation to build, sell, and grow.
payload.longDescription: Shopify for ChatGPT 让开设、运营和发展网店像对话一样简单。使用 Shopify 的 AI 商店构建工具，将小生意的想法转化为电商网站：描述所售商品，创建商店，添加产品，然后在线销售。已有 Shopify 商店？连接后即可管理各地点的库存、创建折扣码、查看订单和客户详情，并获取商店经营表现的分析数据。Shopify 支持线上销售、线下销售、B2B、在交易平台销售以及国际销售。无论你经营按需印刷业务、销售数字产品、运营精品网店、采用一件代发，还是服务批发买家，Shopify 都能为你提供搭建业务、开展销售和实现增长的基础。

payload.name: HubSpot
payload.description: 在 HubSpot 中将洞察转化为行动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with your HubSpot data to analyze patterns, create and update records, and manage your CRM operations. Read from and write to deals, contacts, companies, tickets, engagements, and other objects you have permission to access. Prepare reports, update deal stages, log calls and emails, create tasks, or review pipeline details before meetings. Use it for quick updates in chat or comprehensive CRM management, all grounded in your actual HubSpot data. Learn more: https://knowledge.hubspot.com/integrations/connect-your-hubspot-account-to-chatgpt
payload.longDescription: 利用 HubSpot 数据分析规律、创建和更新记录，并管理 CRM 运营。读取和写入你有权限访问的交易、联系人、公司、工单、互动记录及其他对象。准备报告、更新交易阶段、记录通话和邮件、创建任务，或在会议前查看销售管道详情。既可在聊天中快速更新，也可全面管理 CRM，所有操作都基于你的实际 HubSpot 数据。了解更多：https://knowledge.hubspot.com/integrations/connect-your-hubspot-account-to-chatgpt

payload.name: Windsor.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Windsor.ai connects your marketing and business data sources to your AI assistant, so you can ask questions and take action in plain English.

It pulls performance data from any connected source, and on supported ad and marketing platforms it can make changes directly, such as pausing or enabling a campaign, setting a budget, creating a Google Business Profile post, or replying to a review, always after you confirm.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions across every connected ad account
- Find and pause an underperforming Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Microsoft Ads campaign
- Post or reply as your Instagram, Threads, Facebook, or Google Business Profile account
- Pull GA4, Google Search Console, or YouTube Analytics data straight into the conversation
- Sync HubSpot, Salesforce, or Shopify records
- Update a Klaviyo flow or an Amazon Seller Central listing

Connects to 350+ sources across advertising, analytics, organic social, CRM, e-commerce, email, and payments, including Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Company Pages, Microsoft Ads (Bing), GA4, Google Search Console, YouTube, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Google Merchant Center, Stripe, and GoHighLevel.

Reading data only requires connecting the relevant account once. Making a change (pausing a campaign, posting content, replying to a review) always asks for your confirmation first, and it is only available on platforms Windsor explicitly supports write access for. Every other connected source is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription:
Windsor.ai 将营销和业务数据源连接到你的 AI 助手，让你可以用日常英语提问并执行操作。

它可以从任何已连接的数据源获取表现数据，也可以在支持的广告和营销平台上直接进行修改，例如暂停或启用广告活动、设置预算、创建 Google Business Profile 帖子或回复评价；这些修改始终会在你确认后才执行。

常见工作流：
- 比较所有已连接广告账户的花费、点击和转化
- 找出并暂停表现不佳的 Meta Ads、Google Ads、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads 或 Microsoft Ads 广告活动
- 以你的 Instagram、Threads、Facebook 或 Google Business Profile 账户发布内容或回复
- 将 GA4、Google Search Console 或 YouTube Analytics 数据直接引入对话
- 同步 HubSpot、Salesforce 或 Shopify 记录
- 更新 Klaviyo 流程或 Amazon Seller Central 商品页面

连接广告、分析、自然流量社交媒体、CRM、电商、邮件和支付领域的 350+ 个数据源，包括 Google Ads、Meta (Facebook) Ads、Instagram、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads、LinkedIn Company Pages、Microsoft Ads (Bing)、GA4、Google Search Console、YouTube、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Shopify、Klaviyo、Amazon Ads、Google Merchant Center、Stripe 和 GoHighLevel。

读取数据只需连接一次相关账户。任何修改操作（暂停广告活动、发布内容、回复评价）都会先要求你确认，而且仅适用于 Windsor 明确支持写入权限的平台。其他所有已连接数据源均为只读。提供免费套餐，无需信用卡。

Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台不存在关联，也未获这些平台背书。

payload.name: vidIQ
payload.description: 在 YouTube、IG 和 TikTok 上增长
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next video idea, learn from other creators, and improve your content with vidIQ in ChatGPT.

With vidIQ, you can:

• Find ideas and study competitors: discover videos outperforming their creators’ usual results on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. Find similar YouTube channels and explore their uploads.

• Check demand before filming: compare YouTube keyword search estimates and competition, explore related terms, and see views-per-hour trends where available.

• Understand your channel and audience: review YouTube views, watch time, retention and traffic sources. Explore comments for questions and ideas for your next video.

• Learn from other videos: break down hooks, structure and key moments with YouTube transcripts and visual analysis of videos, Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikToks.

• Improve your titles and thumbnails: get feedback on YouTube titles and thumbnails, generate alternative titles, and compare vidIQ scores before choosing what to test.

• Create and repurpose content: write scripts, generate creative assets, and turn long videos into vertical clips for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 中的 vidIQ，寻找下一个视频创意、向其他创作者学习并改进内容。

借助 vidIQ，你可以：

payload.name: DNS Doctor - DNS & DMARC Tools
payload.summaryOriginal: Scan, fix and verify your DNS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check, fix and verify any domain's DNS, explained in plain English. DNS Doctor reads the records behind a domain, tells you what is wrong and why, and gives you the exact record to publish when there is one.

Scan a domain for email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), mail routing (MX), DNS health, blacklists and domain and SSL certificate expiry. Look up any record on the domain's own nameservers, see whether a change has reached resolvers in six locations, check reverse DNS for a mail server, count SPF lookups, audit the third-party includes an SPF record trusts, and read a domain's registration: registrar, expiry, nameservers and locks.

DMARC records are generated and validated by a deterministic engine that follows the RFCs. The AI writes the explanation, never the record. SPF is diagnosed but never rewritten, because a changed SPF record can silently cut off a real sender. Nothing is applied to your DNS: you publish every record yourself.

Connect your DNS Doctor account to work with your monitored domains from ChatGPT: add a domain, check its ownership record, and read the alerts DNS Doctor raises for record changes, expiry, blacklisting, registrar or nameserver changes and new email senders seen in DMARC reports. It also tells you when that report evidence says it is safe to move DMARC from none to quarantine and then to reject.

扫描域名的邮件认证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）、邮件路由（MX）、DNS健康状况、黑名单以及域名和SSL证书到期情况。可查询域名自有DNS服务器上的任意记录，查看变更是否已到达六个地区的解析器，检查邮件服务器的反向DNS，统计SPF查询次数，审计SPF记录信任的第三方来源，并查看域名的注册信息：注册商、到期时间、DNS服务器和锁定状态。

DMARC记录由遵循RFC标准的确定性引擎生成并验证。AI仅负责撰写解释说明，不生成记录本身。SPF会进行诊断但不会被修改，因为更改SPF记录可能无声地切断真实发件人。您的DNS不会被任何操作影响：所有记录需您自行发布。

Freelancers can search and save jobs, submit proposals, respond to invitations and offers, track earnings and time reports, and manage their public profile. Both sides get a consolidated dashboard of what's new.
payload.longDescription: Upwork将需要招聘的客户与自由职业者对接。客户可发布职位、审查提案、发送报价、与自由职业者沟通，并管理合同、里程碑及付款。自由职业者可搜索保存职位、提交提案、回应邀请与报价、跟踪收入与工时报告，并管理个人资料。双方均可查看整合版的最新动态仪表盘。

payload.name: ActiveCampaign
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You already work in ChatGPT. Now drive and track your marketing outcomes there too.
Connect ActiveCampaign in a few clicks. From the chat, you can:

- Understand yesterday's campaign performance in seconds
- Look up a contact and update their information.
- Clean up tags, build segments, and organize your lists.
- Move deals forward without leaving ChatGPT.
- Enroll a contact in automated marketing workflows.

No new tab. No copy paste. No starting over. ChatGPT is the surface you ask from. ActiveCampaign takes action.
payload.longDescription:
你已经在 ChatGPT 中工作，现在也可以在这里推动并跟踪营销成果。
点击几次即可连接 ActiveCampaign。在聊天中，你可以：

- 几秒内了解昨天的营销活动表现
- 查找联系人并更新其信息。
- 清理标签、建立细分群组并整理列表。
- 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可推进交易。
- 将联系人加入自动化营销工作流程。

无需新开标签页，无需复制粘贴，无需从头再来。你在 ChatGPT 中提出请求，ActiveCampaign 负责执行。

payload.name: SE Ranking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SE Ranking connects ChatGPT to SE Ranking's SEO data and project APIs. Research keywords, analyze backlinks and referring domains, study domain and competitor traffic, pull live SERP data, run website audits, track AI Search visibility across ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/AI Overview, and manage rank-tracking projects you own.
payload.longDescription: SE Ranking 将 ChatGPT 连接到 SE Ranking 的 SEO 数据和项目 API。研究关键词、分析反向链接和引荐域名、研究域名及竞争对手流量、获取实时 SERP 数据、执行网站审计、追踪 ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/AI Overview 中的 AI 搜索可见度，并管理你拥有的排名追踪项目。

payload.name: HoneyBook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HoneyBook is where independent businesses and lean teams run their client work: inquiries, proposals, contracts, invoices, payments and the messages in between.

Connect your account and work through a whole job in one conversation. Ask which leads are worth chasing and get a ranked answer from your own bookings. Have the proposal built from your saved template. Review it before it goes anywhere. Later, ask who still owes you money, and raise a payment request for whoever does.

You approve what it can reach before anything runs, resource by resource, and nothing reaches a client until you send it. Each request runs in an isolated environment, and your credentials are never shared with the model.

Built for photographers, event planners, venues, designers and consultants. Requires a HoneyBook account.
payload.longDescription:
HoneyBook 为独立经营者和精简团队提供管理客户工作的场所：咨询、提案、合同、发票、付款，以及各环节之间的消息沟通。

连接账户后，在一次对话中处理完整业务。询问哪些潜在客户值得跟进，它会根据你自己的已预约业务给出排序结果。使用已保存的模板生成提案，并在发出前审阅。之后，可以询问谁还欠款，并向欠款客户发起付款请求。

任何操作运行前，你需要逐项批准它可访问的资源；只有你发送后，内容才会到达客户。每项请求都在隔离环境中运行，你的凭据绝不会共享给模型。

专为摄影师、活动策划人员、场地经营者、设计师和顾问打造。需要 HoneyBook 账户。

payload.name: Sanity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create, query, and manage your structured content in Sanity directly from ChatGPT. Run content audits, update documents, coordinate releases, and find anything across your projects. Or set up entirely new projects – schemas, content, and configuration – just by chatting.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中创建、查询和管理 Sanity 结构化内容。执行内容审核、更新文档、协调发布，并在项目中查找任何内容。也可以只通过聊天设置全新的项目，包括 schema、内容和配置。

payload.name: Planning Center
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Planning Center to ChatGPT to interact with your ministry data through natural conversation. Each user connects with their own account, so ChatGPT only sees what their Planning Center permissions allow.
payload.longDescription: 将 Planning Center 连接到 ChatGPT，通过自然对话使用您的事工数据。每位用户都连接自己的账户，因此 ChatGPT 只能查看该用户 Planning Center 权限所允许的数据。

payload.name: Windsor.ai Google Ads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Windsor.ai Google Ads helps marketers analyze live Google Ads performance. Users can discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and segmentation options, query campaign, ad group, and keyword metrics, connect the Google Ads connector, and safely run supported Google Ads actions such as creating, pausing, enabling, and updating campaigns, ad groups, ads, and keywords, setting budgets, managing bidding, and managing Customer Match audience lists, after confirmation. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription: Windsor.ai Google Ads 帮助营销人员分析实时 Google Ads 成效。用户可以发现已连接的广告账户、查看有效字段和细分选项、查询广告系列、广告组和关键字指标、连接 Google Ads 连接器，并在确认后安全执行受支持的 Google Ads 操作，例如创建、暂停、启用和更新广告系列、广告组、广告和关键字，设置预算、管理出价以及管理 Customer Match 受众名单。Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Business Strategy Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your business idea into a clear, shareable strategy.
Use this whether you are starting a new business or sharpening an existing one.
It helps you find the right words to explain what you do, for whom, and why it matters.
That gives you clarity for yourself before you bring others in.
It also helps you make real choices and trade-offs instead of keeping everything open.
You work toward a complete Business Strategy Canvas that fits on one page.
This one-page canvas becomes a simple reference you can use to align decisions and priorities.
At the end, you can export a PPTX presentation to share with co-founders, teammates, clients, or stakeholders.
Use the PPTX to pitch, get buy-in, or kick off a strategy session with everyone on the same page.
If your thinking feels scattered, this turns it into something you can communicate and act on.
payload.longDescription:
将您的商业想法转化为清晰、可分享的策略。无论您是在创办新企业，还是在打磨现有企业，都可以使用它。它帮助您找到合适的语言，说明您做什么、为谁做以及为什么重要，从而在引入他人前先获得自己的清晰认识。它还帮助您做出真实的选择和权衡，而不是让所有选项一直开放。
您将逐步完成一页纸的商业策略画布。这张画布可作为对齐决策和优先级的简单参考。最后，您可以导出 PPTX 演示文稿，与联合创始人、队友、客户或利益相关者分享。用 PPTX 做展示、争取支持，或在所有人目标一致的情况下启动策略会议。如果您的思路杂乱，它会把思路变成可沟通、可行动的方案。

payload.name: Windsor.ai Search Console
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Windsor.ai Google Search Console helps SEOs and marketers explore live Search Console data. Users can discover connected Search Console sites, inspect valid dimensions and metrics, and query organic search performance — clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position by query, page, country, device, and date — over any date range, and connect the Search Console connector. It provides read-only analytics: it does not run write actions, submit or change sitemaps, or modify any Search Console settings. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription: Windsor.ai Google Search Console 帮助 SEO 人员和营销人员查看实时 Search Console 数据。用户可以发现已连接的 Search Console 网站，查看有效维度和指标，并按任意日期范围查询自然搜索表现——按查询词、页面、国家/地区、设备和日期细分的点击次数、展示次数、点击率（CTR）和平均排名——还可连接 Search Console 连接器。它提供只读分析：不会执行写入操作、提交或更改站点地图，也不会修改任何 Search Console 设置。Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Clutch.co
payload.description: 寻找理想的 B2B 合作伙伴
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Clutch.co brings trusted B2B service provider research and verified client reviews into ChatGPT, helping you confidently find and compare agencies, consultants, and software partners. Discover thousands of vetted companies across marketing, development, design, IT services, and more—each backed by in-depth profiles and detailed feedback from real clients.

Ask questions like “Which digital marketing agencies have the best reviews for SaaS companies?” or “Compare top web development firms based on client satisfaction,” and Clutch highlights review insights, strengths and weaknesses, pricing signals, and relevant experience. Refine your shortlist through natural conversation and make more informed B2B decisions with transparent, review-driven insights—right inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Clutch.co 将可信的 B2B 服务提供商研究和经过验证的客户评价带入 ChatGPT，帮助您自信地寻找和比较代理机构、顾问和软件合作伙伴。发现营销、开发、设计、IT 服务等领域数千家经过审核的公司，每家公司都有详细档案和真实客户反馈。

您可以问：“哪些数字营销机构最适合 SaaS 公司且评价最好？”或“根据客户满意度比较顶尖网页开发公司。”Clutch 会突出评价洞察、优势和弱点、价格信号及相关经验。通过自然对话完善候选名单，借助透明、以评价为基础的洞察，在 ChatGPT 内做出更明智的 B2B 决策。

payload.name: Wialon
payload.description: 随时询问你的车队情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore your fleet data effortlessly through conversation. Wialon — the ultimate fleet digitalization solution tracking 4 million vehicles in 160 countries — brings your real-time operational insights directly into ChatGPT.

Simply ask questions about your vehicle statuses, trips, fuel activity, or geofences, and get clear, visual answers in seconds. It’s a faster, more intuitive way to stay on top of your operations, right where you already chat.

The app is read-only by design, ensuring a secure and transparent way to explore your data at any time.
payload.longDescription:
通过对话轻松探索车队数据。Wialon 是一款车队数字化解决方案，追踪 160 个国家/地区的 4 million 辆车辆，可将实时运营洞察直接带入 ChatGPT。

只需询问车辆状态、行程、燃油活动或地理围栏，即可在几秒钟内获得清晰直观的答案。无需离开熟悉的聊天界面，就能以更快捷、更直观的方式掌握运营情况。

该应用在设计上仅提供只读访问，让你随时以安全、透明的方式探索数据。

payload.name: Upload-Post
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Upload-Post helps users publish, schedule, analyze, and manage social media posts from ChatGPT. It supports video, photo, text, and document publishing; scheduling and queue management; analytics; profile management; Instagram comments and DMs; browser-based media staging; and FFmpeg media processing across connected social platforms.
payload.longDescription: Upload-Post 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中发布、安排、分析和管理社交媒体帖子。它支持发布视频、照片、文本和文档；安排发布并管理队列；查看分析数据；管理个人资料；处理 Instagram 评论和私信；通过浏览器暂存媒体；以及在已连接的社交平台上使用 FFmpeg 处理媒体。

payload.name: Tailwind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tailwind helps users generate Pinterest Pin drafts from webpages, browse connected accounts, boards, board lists and board sections, create and manage boards, research public Pinterest group boards by topic, review drafts and recommended posting times, check an account's subscription status, manage a saved keywords list, schedule Pins, edit the copy on drafts and scheduled Pins, and delete unpublished Pins through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Tailwind 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 从网页生成 Pinterest Pin 草稿，浏览已连接的账户、画板、画板列表和分区，创建和管理画板，按主题研究公开的 Pinterest 群组画板，查看草稿和推荐发布时间，检查账户订阅状态，管理已保存的关键词列表，安排 Pin 发布，编辑草稿和已排期 Pin 的文案，并删除尚未发布的 Pin。

payload.name: AdKit - Ads Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AdKit connects your ad accounts to ChatGPT so you can manage advertising in plain language. 

Analyze campaign performance, create campaign drafts, research competitor ads, and generate ad creatives across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Reddit Ads workflows. 

Changes stay draft-first for review and only publish after explicit approval, so ChatGPT can help you move faster without silently changing live campaigns.
payload.longDescription:
AdKit 将广告账户连接至 ChatGPT，让你用自然语言管理广告。

在 Google Ads、Meta Ads、TikTok Ads 和 Reddit Ads 工作流程中，分析营销活动表现、创建活动草稿、研究竞争对手广告并生成广告创意。

变更会先保留为草稿供审核，仅在明确批准后发布，让 ChatGPT 帮你更快推进工作，而不会悄然修改正在投放的活动。

payload.name: Twenty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Twenty helps users work with their CRM workspace from ChatGPT by discovering available tools, learning tool schemas, searching Twenty documentation, loading workspace skills, and executing permitted CRM actions such as finding, creating, updating, or deleting records and drafting or sending email when the user's role allows it.
payload.longDescription: Twenty 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 使用 CRM 工作区：发现可用工具、了解工具架构、搜索 Twenty 文档、加载工作区技能，并执行获准的 CRM 操作，例如查找、创建、更新或删除记录，以及在用户角色获准时起草或发送电子邮件。

payload.name: Nifty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Nifty to ChatGPT to analyze and organize your reselling business across every marketplace you sell on. ChatGPT can search and filter inventory, pull full item details and photos, check inventory health, manage favorites, private notes, and labels, review order history and expenses, edit items and update marketplace listings, and analyze sales, profit, and sell-through. Nifty unifies inventory and sales for resellers on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy, and Whatnot.
payload.longDescription: 将 Nifty 连接到 ChatGPT，分析并整理你在各个市场经营的转售业务。ChatGPT 可以搜索和筛选库存，获取完整商品详情和照片，检查库存状况，管理收藏、私密备注和标签，查看订单历史和费用，编辑商品并更新市场列表，还能分析销售、利润和售罄率。Nifty 统一管理 eBay、Poshmark、Mercari、Depop、Etsy 和 Whatnot 上转售商的库存与销售。
